comment: Independent learned-spell entry for C38. A lawful human Priest uses a blessed remove-curse spellbook; #levelchange provides power for its level-3 study, and ordinary Zc selects the learned spell. C reaches spell.c:docast -> spelleffects(SPE_REMOVE_CURSE) -> read.c:seffects -> seffect_remove_curse. The eight spaces dismiss each intermediate #levelchange pager; one more space dismisses the study-start pager before study completes.
